days.file: Friedrich, Caspar David - Morgen im Riesengebirge.jpg
days.title: Morning in the Riesengebirge
days.alt: A small cross stands on a rocky peak above layer after layer of blue hills in the soft light of dawn.
days.look: Look again at the small cross on the rock, high above the hills. Where are your eyes resting as this journey begins?
days.license: Artist died 1840; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.title: Abraham’s Journey from Ur to Canaan
days.alt: Abraham, white-bearded in a white turban and mantle, walks ahead with two boys, his household riding camels behind him with their flocks.
days.look: Look again at Abraham’s steady face as he leads his household into the unknown. What would it mean for you to take the next step in trust?
days.license: Artist died 1899; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.title: Tobias and the Angel
days.alt: The winged Archangel Raphael walks hand in hand with young Tobias, dressed as a traveler in a red cape and cap.
days.look: Look again at Tobias’s hand held in the angel’s. Who has God sent to walk beside you without your noticing?
days.license: Artists died 1498 and c. 1496; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.title: The Walk to Emmaus
days.alt: Jesus, in a red robe, walks between two disciples on a country road, one of them turned toward Him in earnest talk.
days.look: Look again at Jesus walking between the two travelers at their pace. What would you tell Him on the road today?
days.license: Artist died 1876; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Christ sur la mer de Galilée (Delacroix) Walters Art Museum 37.186.jpg
days.title: Christ on the Sea of Galilee
days.alt: A small boat with torn sails is tossed on dark green waves, the frightened disciples crowding around Jesus, who sleeps in the stern.
days.look: Look again at the disciples clinging to the boat while Jesus rests in the stern. What storm do you need to wake Him for today?
days.license: Artist died 1863; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.title: Joseph, Overseer of Pharaoh’s Granaries
days.alt: Joseph, in white robes, sits on a carved Egyptian chair holding a staff, while a scribe kneels beside him recording the grain.
days.look: Look again at Joseph, a foreigner, faithfully at work for the good of Egypt. How can you bless the place where you live and work?
days.license: Artist died 1912; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Saint Paul Writing, 1520s, Pier Francesco Sacchi.jpg
days.title: Saint Paul Writing
days.alt: St. Paul, bearded and in a blue robe and red cloak, sits at his desk writing a letter, a crucifix standing beside him.
days.look: Look again at Paul’s pen moving across the page to people he could not see. Who far away is waiting for a word from you?
days.license: Artist died 1528; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Brooklyn Museum - The Return from Egypt (Retour d'Égypte) - James Tissot - overall.jpg
days.title: The Return from Egypt
days.alt: Joseph, loaded with their belongings, walks beside a donkey carrying the young Jesus, while Mary in a white veil follows on a stony path among olive trees.
days.look: Look again at Joseph, loaded with their belongings, walking beside the donkey on the road home. What step toward home is God asking of you or your loved one?
days.license: Artist died 1902; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.title: The Return of Tobias
days.alt: Tobias, back from his journey, is embraced by his mother Anna in a white veil and kissed by his father Tobit, while the Archangel Raphael stands beside them with a traveler’s staff.
days.look: Look again at the welcome on Anna’s and Tobit’s faces, with the angel close behind. Which homecoming do you want to thank God for?
days.license: Artist died 1905; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)
